elements.name: open bus station yard in early morning
soft gold light and long shadows
single-file queue of men and women seen from behind curving across the yard
small ticket window in a low building
young man with backpack as last person in queue, nearest to viewer, seen from behind
long-distance buses parked along one side

notes: Re-stage the crowd as one clear single-file line curving to the ticket window with the young man alone at its end; right now it splits into two parallel rows, the woman in red stands level beside him, and buses flank both sides of the yard instead of one.
